verdict_rationale: Short-horizon s=0 cells beat matched-random and weaken under +6h shift, but successful-breakout control shows stronger—not weaker—reversion-signed returns, so closing back inside is not incremental to an ordinary boundary breach. Stronger overshoot (s=0.10) is worse, not better. Effect is ~1 bp at 15m, fades by 120–240m, and UPPER is weaker than LOWER. Primary close-return does not support the failed-breakout-specific mechanism. Not reframed as a general range-touch bounce hypothesis in this task.
